arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case contends the statute reserves severe punishment for specific federal offenses.
The government argues the statute picks up definitions from federal provisions to cover state crimes.
Justice Kennedy noted Congress used similar statutory styles in later laws, favoring the government's view.
Justice Kagan asked if Congress intended to capture every conceivable state statute involving minors.
